title: Incremental Stay
statementMd:
*[Danimal Cannon, Zef - The Lunar Whale](https://soundcloud.com/danimalcannon/the-lunar-whale)*⠀

You are the security guard of a museum.

The main door of the museum is both an entrance and an exit. At most one person can pass through the door every second. There is a sensor that detects when a visitor passes through the door. The sensor cannot determine neither who the visitor is, nor whether he entered or exited the museum. The sensor detected some activity in $2n$ distinct moments of time $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_{2n}$ (measured in seconds).

For each visitor, his stay time is equal to the exit time minus the entrance time.

Right now the museum is closed (so it has no visitors), and you wonder about the maximum possible total stay time today, i.e., the maximum possible sum of the stay times of all the visitors that entered the museum today. At second $0$, the museum was closed as well.

For security reasons, there is also a limit on the number of people who can stay in the museum simultaneously, but you forgot this limit. For each $k$ from $1$ to $n$, you want to determine the maximum possible total stay time today, assuming that at most $k$ people can stay in the museum simultaneously.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$). The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains a single integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$), indicating that the sensor detected some activity in $2n$ distinct moments of time.

The second line of each test case contains $2n$ integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_{2n}$ ($1 \leq a_1 \lt a_2 \lt \ldots \lt a_{2n} \leq 10^9$) — the seconds when the sensor detected some activity.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $2 \cdot 10^5$.

## Output

For each test case, print $n$ integers: for each $k$ from $1$ to $n$, print the maximum possible total stay time today, assuming that at most $k$ people can stay in the museum simultaneously.

## Note

In the first test case, the sensor detected activity at seconds $32$ and $78$. Recall that $k$ is the maximum number of people who can stay in the museum simultaneously.

- If $k$ is $1$, the maximum possible total stay time is $46$, reached if visitor $1$ enters at time $32$ and exits at time $78$.

In the second test case, the sensor detected activity at seconds $4$, $5$, $6$, and $9$.

- If $k$ is $1$, the maximum possible total stay time is $4$, reached if visitor $1$ enters at time $4$ and exits at time $5$, and visitor $2$ enters at time $6$ and exits at time $9$.
- If $k$ is $2$, the maximum possible total stay time is $6$, reached if visitor $1$ enters at time $4$ and exits at time $9$, and visitor $2$ enters at time $5$ and exits at time $6$.
statementZhMd:
*[Danimal Cannon, Zef - The Lunar Whale](https://soundcloud.com/danimalcannon/the-lunar-whale)*⠀

你是一家博物馆的保安。

博物馆的正门既是入口也是出口。每秒钟最多有一人通过这扇门。有一个传感器可以检测到访客何时通过这扇门，但传感器既无法确定访客是谁，也无法确定他是进入了博物馆还是离开了博物馆。传感器在 $2n$ 个互不相同的时刻 $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_{2n}$（以秒计）检测到了活动。

对每位访客而言，他的停留时间等于离开时刻减去进入时刻。

现在博物馆已经闭馆（因此里面没有访客），你想知道今天可能的总停留时间最大是多少，即今天所有进入过博物馆的访客的停留时间之和的最大可能值。在第 $0$ 秒时，博物馆同样是关闭的。

出于安全原因，同时留在博物馆内的人数也有一个上限，但你忘记了这个上限。对于从 $1$ 到 $n$ 的每个 $k$，你都想求出今天可能的总停留时间的最大值，假设同时留在博物馆内的人数至多为 $k$。

## 输入格式

输入包含多组测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）。接下来是各组测试用例的描述。

每组测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$1 \leq n \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$），表示传感器在 $2n$ 个互不相同的时刻检测到了活动。

每组测试用例的第二行包含 $2n$ 个整数 $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_{2n}$（$1 \leq a_1 \lt a_2 \lt \ldots \lt a_{2n} \leq 10^9$）——传感器检测到活动时所对应的秒数。

保证所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $2 \cdot 10^5$。

## 输出格式

对于每组测试用例，输出 $n$ 个整数：对于从 $1$ 到 $n$ 的每个 $k$，输出今天可能的总停留时间的最大值，假设同时留在博物馆内的人数至多为 $k$。

## 说明

在第一组测试用例中，传感器在第 $32$ 秒和第 $78$ 秒检测到了活动。回忆一下，$k$ 表示同时留在博物馆内的最大人数。

- 若 $k$ 为 $1$，则总停留时间的最大值为 $46$，当访客 $1$ 在时刻 $32$ 进入并在时刻 $78$ 离开时取得。

在第二组测试用例中，传感器在第 $4$、$5$、$6$ 和 $9$ 秒检测到了活动。

- 若 $k$ 为 $1$，则总停留时间的最大值为 $4$，当访客 $1$ 在时刻 $4$ 进入并在时刻 $5$ 离开，且访客 $2$ 在时刻 $6$ 进入并在时刻 $9$ 离开时取得。
- 若 $k$ 为 $2$，则总停留时间的最大值为 $6$，当访客 $1$ 在时刻 $4$ 进入并在时刻 $9$ 离开，且访客 $2$ 在时刻 $5$ 进入并在时刻 $6$ 离开时取得。
